title: Why build an alert rule query?

blocks.content:
The query is the foundation of every alert rule. It tells Grafana which data to watch. Without a well-defined query, Grafana can't check conditions or send notifications.

A good query returns exactly the data you care about: the right metric, from the right systems, over the right time window. Getting this right means your alerts fire for real problems and stay quiet when things are fine.

In the next milestone, you'll navigate to the alert rule page and start building.
